notes: Next.js 16 app router (next 16.2.8). The mark is app/icon.svg, a rainbow-gradient four-point star on a #06040f tile, kept exactly as drawn on 2026-06-09. The artcraft-brand generator refuses it ('marks must use flat hex colours ... VectorCraft paints those black'), so this is a hand-made kit: brand/kit/recipe.mjs draws the SVG with Chrome at each size and writes the PNGs and the ICO itself.

The recipe writes to brand/kit/out/, which git ignores, and the copies the site serves are in public/. In a fresh checkout check.mjs warns that kit/out is missing; after running the recipe it compares public/ with kit/out byte for byte. Same Chrome, same bytes: two runs on 2026-11-10 were identical.

Head tags are written by app/layout.tsx: metadataBase https://kingdom-gate.vercel.app, metadata.icons (/favicon.ico at 32x32, /icon.svg, /apple-touch-icon.png), metadata.manifest, openGraph with SHARE_CARD, twitter summary_large_image, and viewport.themeColor #0b0d12. In next 16.2.8 metadata.icons replaces the links Next would write for app/icon.svg, so the layout names /icon.svg itself; Next still serves the file there. Each page's own title and description fill its og:title and og:description.
color-scheme comes from app/globals.css (html { color-scheme: dark; }); the layout sets no viewport.colorScheme.
The manifest's display is 'browser': the gate is a site, not an app to install. Its colours are the page ground #0b0d12. There is no maskable icon.

check.mjs is not wired yet: the repository has no test script and no CI workflow. Proposed: `"test:brand": "node brand/check.mjs"` in package.json; running it in `prebuild` as well would make every Vercel deploy run it, which is a new blocking guard and the owner's call.

The footer's Codeberg link goes to codeberg.org/zerone-dev, a user account (not an organisation) with no public repositories; its former zerone-dev/zerone and zerone-dev/true-love answer 404 (checked 2026-11-10). No live Codeberg mirror was found, so the link stays until the owner chooses.
